definitions.source_verified: Source container and required extent SHA/identity confirmed, not a Unity GPU claim
definitions.export_verified: AssetRipper same-instance output or an exact source-to-export link is checked, not a device claim
definitions.unity_verified: Explicit Unity Editor 2021.3.45f2 proof for stated scope, not necessarily source-equivalent shader
definitions.packaged: A signed complete Android package was validated at a particular commit, not every pixel
definitions.device_verified: Phone output/diagnostics specifically validate stated resource scope
definitions.blocked: A required authentic identity, sampler, kernel or original program is missing
definitions.pending: Work not yet evidenced; cannot count as restored
